Usage: select the "Sprint1_Local" environment, start the services (python main.py), run "00 Auth helpers" first, then run each folder's requests in order. Every request name starts with the full name of the student who developed that API, and every request checks its expected status code.

item.name: 00 Auth helpers
item.description: Shared by the whole team. Run this folder first (Run folder). Each request logs in one test account through the User Login API and stores its JWT in the environment (admin_token, analyst_token, employee_token, auditor_token, ...), which every other folder uses. Tokens expire after 60 minutes.

item.name: 01 Users

Users and Identity Management Service (port 5001): registration, login, profile updates, deletion and lookups with role-based access control.

Developed by: Hassane El Khatib

item.name: Hassane El Khatib - User Registration - regular user success [A-01]

request.description:
**User Registration** (POST /users/register)

Creates an account. Anyone may register a Regular User; only a Security Administrator (Bearer token) may create other roles.

Body: `full_name`, `username`, `email`, `password`, `department`, `role` (all required).

Validation: required fields, email format, username 3-30 letters/digits/underscores and unique, email unique, password at least 8 characters with upper, lower, digit and special character, role one of the 4 roles.

Success: 201 with the created user (no password).

Errors: 400 validation, 403 non-admin creating a privileged role, 409 duplicate username or email.
